convert_text_completion_to_chat_response: convert the text completion response object to a chat model response object with message content and role
get_supported_openai_params: get the list of supported OpenAI parameters for a given model string
transform_text_completion_request: transform messages and optional parameters into a text completion request dictionary with model and prompt
build_openai_text_completion_config: build an OpenAITextCompletionConfig instance with best_of, echo, frequency_penalty, logit_bias, max_tokens, stop, suffix, temperature, and top_p
get_openai_text_completion_config: get the configuration dictionary from OpenAITextCompletionConfig using get_config
